headline: Trump administration can hold immigrants in ICE custody without bond, court rules
summary: The Bluebonnet Detention Center in Anson, operated by Management & Training Corporation under ICE contract, remains open despite local opposition. ICE's continued use of private detention facilities, like Bluebonnet, reflects the federal government's ongoing immigration enforcement policies.

headline: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway announced she is dropping reelection bid
summary: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway ends reelection bid due to safety concerns, mentioning toxic political culture and threats. Protests occurred around police shooting, with activists shouting "shame" during council meeting.

headline: Immigrants in ICE detention have no due process rights under US Constitution, federal appeals court says
summary: The 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that immigrants entering the U.S. without appointments can be detained indefinitely without bond hearings, impacting over 20,000 detainees in Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi. The 10-7 decision, praised by the Department of Homeland Security, reverses an earlier decision granting bond after 90 days. Immigrant rights advocates argue this ruling infringes on constitutional rights and detainees' personal liberty.

headline: LA chemical plant on short leash from state regulators as neighbors continue to protest its operations
summary: The California Board of Environmental Safety reviewed an appeal by neighbors and company Phibro-Tech against the Department of Toxic Substances Control's permit renewal for Phibro-Tech's waste facility. The board agreed with neighbors that the permit renewal process was flawed, but allowed the facility to continue operating while reassessment occurs. The decision was a first for the board in its five-year history and showed differing views on the board's authority.

headline: First influenza-related death of 2026-27 season reported in Idaho
summary: Idaho reports its first flu death of the season, an Owyhee County man over 65. Flu activity is rising, with higher-than-usual emergency visits. Public health officials urge Idahoans to get vaccinated and take precautions like hand washing to prevent spread. High-risk groups, including those over 65, are encouraged to take extra precautions.

headline: Jackson changes course after initially saying he would skip second Trump rally this month
summary: Republican gubernatorial candidate Rick Jackson joins President Trump at two rallies this weekend, drawing criticism from Democrats who tie him to Trump's low approval ratings in Georgia. Early voting is underway ahead of the Nov. 3 election.
